**[Recall Knowledge - Beast](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2), [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10)): DC 41 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 39 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 36 [Mighty Bul-Gae](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2585) **Source** [Pathfinder #192: Worst of All Possible Worlds](/Sources.aspx?ID=203) pg. 20 **Perception** +30; [greater darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=12), [scent](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=33) ([imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=412)) 60 feet **Languages** [Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1) **Skills** [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +32, [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) +29, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +30, [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=16) +32 **Str** +9 **Dex** +5 **Con** +8 **Int** +5 **Wis** +7 **Cha** +4 --- **AC** 40 **Fort** +33 **Ref** +26 **Will** +30 **HP** 310 **Resistances** [cold](/Traits.aspx?ID=27) 15, [fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72) 15 **Eclipse Aura** ([aura](/Traits.aspx?ID=206), [darkness](/Traits.aspx?ID=39), [occult](/Traits.aspx?ID=120)) 100 feet. Light and shadows morph strangely around the bul-gae. A creature attempting to create a [light](/Traits.aspx?ID=100) effect within the aura must attempt a DC 5 flat check. On a failure, the attempt fails, the effect is lost, and the DC to [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) [darkness](/Traits.aspx?ID=39) effects within the aura is increased by 1.
**Solar Flare** ([evocation](/Traits.aspx?ID=65), [fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72), [occult](/Traits.aspx?ID=120)) **Trigger** The bul-gae takes damage; **Effect** The bul-gae releases a solar flare in a 30-foot emanation. Each creature in the area takes 6d8 fire damage (DC 38 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save). On a critical failure, a creature also takes 2d10 [persistent fire damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29). After using this ability, the bul-gae's flames cool and they can't use Solar Flare again until after they have used Lunar Burst. --- **Speed** 40 feet, fly 30 feet **Melee** jaws +32 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170)), **Damage** 3d8+17 piercing plus 2d6 cold or fire and [Improved Knockdown](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=28) **Lunar Burst** ([Cold](/Traits.aspx?ID=27), [Evocation](/Traits.aspx?ID=65), [Occult](/Traits.aspx?ID=120)) The bul-gae releases a blast of otherworldly frost that deals 6d8 cold damage to each creature in a 10-foot emanation (DC 38 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save). On a critical failure, a creature also becomes [slowed 2](/Conditions.aspx?ID=35). After using this ability, the bul-gae's flames heat up and they can't use Lunar Burst again until after they have used Solar Flare. **Shadow Leap** ([Conjuration](/Traits.aspx?ID=33), [Occult](/Traits.aspx?ID=120), [Shadow](/Traits.aspx?ID=143), [Teleportation](/Traits.aspx?ID=156)) **Requirements** The bul-gae is in [dim light](/Rules.aspx?ID=408) or [darkness](/Rules.aspx?ID=409); **Effect** The bul-gae dives into a shadow and reappears from another shadow within 40 feet. **Thermal Mastery** The bul-gae has total control over the powers of cold and fire. Each time they attack with their jaws, they can choose either cold or fire for the additional damage.
name: Mighty Bul-Gae
